info.title: ShopNexus API
info.description:
The HTTP contract between the ShopNexus app and its server. The server
validates every request against this document, and the end-to-end suite
validates every response against it. The docs site explains each module:
https://docs.shopnexus.id.vn/en/api.

## Signing in

1. `POST /v1/auth/email-codes` mails a six-digit code to an email address.
2. `POST /v1/auth/sign-in` with that code returns an access token and a
   refresh token. The first sign-in of an address creates the account. A
   phone number Firebase verified or a Google account signs in the same way.
3. Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It lasts 15
   minutes; `POST /v1/auth/refresh` returns a new one and rotates the
   refresh token.

In the playground, paste the access token under Authentication. It stays in
this browser only.

## Requests and answers

- Bodies are JSON. A field the schema does not list is 400.
- A write the app may send twice takes an `Idempotency-Key` header: a new
  UUID per user action, the same one on a retry. A repeated key returns the
  first answer.
- Lists page with `cursor` and `limit`; pass the `next_cursor` of one page to
  get the next.
- Every error has the body `{"error": {"code", "message", "fields",
  "details", "trace_id"}}`. `code` is stable and snake_case, and each operation lists the
  codes it can return. `trace_id` equals the `Trace-Id` header.
- A resource the caller may not see is 404, the same as one that does not
  exist.

## Live updates

`GET /v1/ws` is a WebSocket that tells the open app what changed for the
caller; the playground cannot open it. `GET /v1/updates` returns the same
updates after a `since` seq, for an app with no socket open.

servers.description: Local, from `make dev` in the umbrella repository

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Sign in with an email code, a phone number Firebase verified or a Google account; refresh tokens; list and end sessions.

tags.name: account
tags.description: The caller's profile, phone, addresses, blocks and follows.

tags.name: media
tags.description: Presigned URLs to upload a photo or a video, which a listing or a message then names.

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: Listings and their drafts. A seller posts, edits, hides and marks sold; anyone reads a public listing.

tags.name: assist
tags.description: Fill a listing draft from a video, photos or a Chợ Tốt link, and price it against similar listings.

tags.name: discovery
tags.description: Search and browse listings, saved listings, recent searches and a seller's public listings.

tags.name: chat
tags.description: Conversations between two people and their messages, deal messages included.

tags.name: deal
tags.description: A buyer and a seller agree a price, the buyer asks for cash on delivery, the seller ships and the order closes.

tags.name: shipping
tags.description: The seller's GHTK and GHN accounts, pickup addresses, shipping quotes and the carriers' webhooks.

tags.name: trust
tags.description: Reviews of sellers, reports of listings and accounts, and scam warnings in chat.

tags.name: support
tags.description: Tickets the caller opens with ShopNexus and their chat.

tags.name: notification
tags.description: The caller's notices, their read state, push tokens and notification settings.

tags.name: stream
tags.description: Live updates over a WebSocket, and the same updates by seq for an app with no socket open.

tags.name: screen
tags.description: One call per app screen, with everything that screen shows.

tags.name: console
tags.description: The staff console. It signs in with a session cookie, so the playground cannot call it from another origin.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up.
Readiness: the process can reach its dependencies.

post.summary: Sign in, or sign up on first use, with a phone number Firebase verified, a Google account or an email code.
post.description:
phone_token is what Firebase returned for the number: the ID token of
Firebase Authentication after an SMS code, or the Phone Number
Verification token of the SIM. google_token is the Google ID token
Credential Manager returned; it proves the account's email, and an
email identity with that address is the same account. email_code is
the code sendEmailCode mailed. A token must be at most 5 minutes old.
A repeated Idempotency-Key with a proof of the same address returns
the first sign-in's session with a new refresh token.

401.description: A token failed a check (invalid_phone_token, invalid_google_token), or a repeated Idempotency-Key's session was signed out since (session_revoked, session_expired).

422.description: The verified number is not a Vietnamese mobile number (invalid_phone), or the code is wrong (invalid_code, details.attempts_left), expired or replaced (code_expired) or out of guesses (code_locked).

503.description: The keys that sign phone or Google tokens could not be fetched yet (unavailable); try again.

post.summary: Mail a six-digit code to sign in, or sign up on first use, with an email address.
post.description:
The reply is the same whether or not an account holds the address.
The code lasts 5 minutes and takes 5 guesses. Limits: one code per
address per 45 seconds, five per address per hour, twenty per client
address per hour.

200.description: The code is on its way.

422.description: The address is not valid (invalid_email).

429.description: Too soon after the last code to this address (otp_too_soon), or over a limit (otp_limit); details.retry_after gives seconds.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token.
post.description: A refresh token works once. Presenting it again, or two refreshes racing with one token, signs the session out.

get.summary: List signed-in devices, newest first.

delete.summary: Sign out every session of the account.
delete.description: Needs a sign-in within the last 15 minutes.

delete.summary: Sign out the session this request was made with.
delete.description: The access token keeps working until it expires, at most 15 minutes; the app discards it.

get.summary: Read the caller's account.

patch.summary: Change the display name, the bio or the avatar.
patch.description: A new avatar is processed before the reply, which carries its URL.

422.description: The name or the bio breaks a rule (invalid_account, with fields), or the avatar upload is not the caller's or not a photo media can process (invalid_upload).

delete.description:
Needs a sign-in within 15 minutes. The account's listings, profile,
sign-in methods, addresses, saves, search history, blocks, follows and
notifications go, and its sessions end. The row stays without a name,
bio or avatar for the orders, reviews and messages that name it, where
other people see the account as deleted. A phone of the account signs
up again as a new account. The recipients of the orders it bought are
blanked a year later.

409.description: An order of the caller is pending or shipped (orders_open), or the account changed twice during the call (try_again).

post.summary: Mail a six-digit code that adds this email address to the caller's account.
post.description:
The code works only for the caller's account, through
POST /v1/accounts/me/identities. Needs a sign-in within 15 minutes.
Limits as for sendEmailCode.

200.description: The code is on its way.

422.description: The address is not valid (invalid_email).

429.description: Too soon after the last code to this address (otp_too_soon), or over a limit (otp_limit); details.retry_after gives seconds.

post.summary: Add the phone or email the caller's account lacks.
post.description:
A phone_token adds a phone to an account that has only an email;
google_token or email_code (from sendMyEmailCode) adds an email to an
account that has only a phone. Needs a sign-in within 15 minutes: a
sign-in method is never removed, so one added with a leaked access
token would let its holder in for good.

200.description: The account's identities after the add.

401.description: Not signed in, the account was deleted (session_revoked), or a token failed a check (invalid_phone_token, invalid_google_token).

409.description: The account has this kind already (identity_kind_taken), another account signs in with this value (identity_taken), or a race (try_again).

422.description: invalid_phone, invalid_code (details.attempts_left), code_expired or code_locked.

post.summary: Block an account.
post.description:
Neither the caller nor the account may then message the other, open a
conversation with them or open a deal on their listings. Blocking
again changes nothing; running deals and orders stay as they are.

404.description: No such account (account_not_found).

409.description: ShopNexus cannot be blocked (account_is_system).

422.description: The caller named themselves (invalid_block).

get.summary: List the accounts the caller blocks, newest block first.

delete.summary: Lift a block; an absent one is fine.

post.summary: Follow an account.
post.description:
The caller hears when the account first publishes a listing.
Following again changes nothing. A block between the two, either way,
refuses a follow, and blocking deletes the follows between them.

403.description: The caller is suspended (account_suspended), or a block stands between the two (blocked).

404.description: No such account (account_not_found).

409.description: The caller follows 1,000 accounts (follow_limit_reached), or the account was deleted (account_deleted).

422.description: The caller named themselves (invalid_follow).

get.summary: List the accounts the caller follows, newest follow first.

delete.summary: Stop following an account; an absent follow is fine.

get.summary: List the caller's addresses, the default first, then the newest.

200.description: Every address of the caller's, at most 10.

post.summary: Add an address; the first becomes the default.
post.description: A repeated Idempotency-Key returns the address its first request added, and adds nothing.

409.description: The caller has 10 addresses (address_limit_reached).

422.description: The address breaks a rule (invalid_address, with fields).

put.summary: Replace an address of the caller's.
put.description: Orders already requested to the address keep the copy they took.

404.description: No such address of the caller's (address_not_found).

409.description: The address changed meanwhile (try_again).

422.description: The address breaks a rule (invalid_address, with fields).

delete.summary: Delete an address of the caller's.
delete.description:
When it was the default, the newest remaining address becomes the
default. Orders already requested to it keep the copy they took.

404.description: No such address of the caller's (address_not_found).

post.summary: Make an address of the caller's the default.

404.description: No such address of the caller's (address_not_found).

post.summary: Get a presigned URL to upload one photo or video to.
post.description:
The app PUTs the file to `url` with `headers` before `expires_at`;
the URL fixes the content type and length. Attach a photo to a
listing, or read a video with POST /v1/listing-reads, within 24 hours,
or the upload is deleted.

post.summary: Read a video, a photo or the seller's Chợ Tốt listing into a listing draft.
post.description:
Starts reading what the body names: a video the caller uploaded with
POST /v1/uploads, one photo upload of the caller's, or the link to the
seller's own listing on Chợ Tốt.
A video may carry the phone's transcript; then the server runs no
speech recognition.
The answer comes at once with status reading. Each step that finishes
adds its fields and sends a listing_read update on /v1/ws; the app
then reads the read with GET. Checks, in order: for a link not_a_link
and unsupported_source; then account_suspended, phone_required,
read_limit_reached (30 video reads, 60 photo reads or 30 link reads in
24 hours); then invalid_upload for a video or a photo. A link is not
fetched until the read runs.

403.description: The account is suspended (account_suspended), or has no phone to sign in with (phone_required).

422.description:
The video is not the caller's, not a video, not uploaded yet, expired or already read (invalid_upload); the
photo is not the caller's, not a photo, not uploaded yet, already in a listing or expired (invalid_upload); the
text is not an http or https link (not_a_link), or not a link to a listing on chotot.com (unsupported_source).

429.description: The account started as many reads of this source as its cap allows in the last 24 hours (read_limit_reached).

get.summary: Read a listing read.

200.description: The read as it is now.

404.description: No such read for this caller, or it is past its 24 hours (listing_read_not_found).

post.summary: Preview the listing a pasted link names.
post.description:
Reads the seller's listing on Chợ Tốt for the card the app shows under
the paste field, before the seller asks for a read. Nothing is stored.
POST keeps the link out of access logs.

404.description: Chợ Tốt has no such listing on sale (listing_not_found).

422.description: The text is not an http or https link (not_a_link), or not a link to a listing on chotot.com (unsupported_source).

503.description: Chợ Tốt did not answer (source_unavailable); try again.

post.summary: Price a listing draft against similar listings and the buyers watching for it.
post.description:
Compares the draft with the listings most like it, by text and by
photo, and answers the range, the two suggestions, the similar
listings, their prices, and the search watches a listing of the draft
would match. Stores nothing. POST because the body carries the draft.

200.description: The guide; empty lists when nothing is similar.

422.description:
The category is not a subcategory or the commune is not on the list
(invalid_listing, with fields); a photo is not the caller's, not a
photo, already in a listing or expired (invalid_upload).

post.summary: Post a listing.
post.description:
The listing starts in processing while its photos are processed, then
turns active, or rejected when a photo is refused. Checks, in order:
account_suspended, listing_cap_reached (20 listings in
processing, active, hidden or rejected), invalid_listing, invalid_upload.

403.description: The account is suspended (account_suspended), or has no phone to sign in with (phone_required).

409.description: The seller has 20 listings on sale or hidden (listing_cap_reached).

422.description: A field breaks a rule (invalid_listing, with fields), or an upload is not the caller's, not uploaded yet, or already used (invalid_upload).

get.summary: Read a listing.
get.description:
Anyone may read an active listing. Its seller, signed in, also reads it
in any other status; anyone else gets 404.

404.description: No such listing for this caller (listing_not_found).

put.description:
The body is the whole listing, as when posting. Photos not in the
listing yet take it back to processing until they are processed; an
edit of a rejected listing does too. Sold listings cannot be edited.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is sold or deleted (listing_state_conflict), or changed meanwhile (try_again).

422.description: A field breaks a rule (invalid_listing, with fields), or an added upload is not the caller's, not uploaded yet, or already used (invalid_upload).

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is already deleted (listing_state_conflict), or changed meanwhile (try_again).

post.summary: Take an active listing off sale.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is not active (listing_state_conflict), or changed meanwhile (try_again).

post.summary: Put a hidden listing back on sale.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is not hidden (listing_state_conflict), or changed meanwhile (try_again).

post.summary: Record a sale made off the app.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is not active or hidden (listing_state_conflict), or changed meanwhile (try_again).

post.summary: Undo marking a listing sold; it goes back on sale.

404.description: No such listing of the caller's (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is not sold (listing_state_conflict), the seller has 20 listings on sale or hidden (listing_cap_reached), or it changed meanwhile (try_again).

get.summary: List the caller's listings, newest first.

parameters.name: pane
parameters.description: on_sale holds listings in processing, active, hidden, rejected and reserved; sold holds sold ones.

get.summary: List the caller's drafts.
get.description:
Every draft of the caller's, in full, last edited first; at most 20,
so there are no pages. Drafts past expires_at are deleted first.

put.summary: Create or replace one of the caller's drafts.
put.description:
The app mints the ID, a UUIDv7, so a draft made offline has its ID
before it reaches the server. The last PUT wins. Photos a listing took
or that expired are dropped; each of the others is kept 30 days from
this PUT, and a later PUT never shortens that. The draft is kept 30
days from this PUT. Drafts of the caller's past expires_at are deleted
first, so they free their places.

404.description: The ID is another account's draft (draft_not_found).

409.description: A create when the caller has 20 drafts (draft_limit_reached), or the photos collided with another write (try_again).

422.description: A photo is not the caller's photo upload, waiting before its expiry and in the store as declared (invalid_upload).

delete.summary: Delete one of the caller's drafts.
delete.description: Its photos expire on their own. The app calls it after a post from the draft.

204.description: Deleted, or there was no such draft of the caller's.

get.summary: The category tree.
The provinces, after the 2025 merger.
The communes of a province.
The commune nearest a point, with its province.
get.description:
The commune whose point is closest to lat and lng, as the app asks
when it fills in the area from the phone's position. The communes
table holds one point per commune and no boundaries, so a commune
farther than 30 km counts as none. The point is used for this request
only; it is neither stored nor logged.

404.description: No commune lies within 30 km of the point (no_commune_near).

post.summary: Open the caller's deal on a listing.
post.description:
Returns the caller's existing deal on the listing, or starts one.
Checks, in order: the caller's deal exists (200); the listing exists;
account_suspended; own_listing; listing_unavailable. A new deal opens
the conversation of the buyer and the seller, or reuses the pair's,
and names it in conversation_id. The conversation shows in the inbox
once it has a message.

403.description: The account is suspended (account_suspended), has no phone to sign in with (phone_required), or a block stands between the buyer and the seller (blocked).

404.description: No such listing (listing_not_found).

409.description: The listing is the caller's (own_listing) or not on sale (listing_unavailable).

get.summary: Read a deal, as its buyer or its seller.

404.description: No such deal of the caller's (deal_not_found).

post.summary: Make an offer, or a counter to the buyer's offer.
post.description:
The buyer offers; the seller counters the buyer's open offer. The
amount must lie inside the deal's offer_range.

404.description: No such deal of the caller's (deal_not_found).

409.description: The deal's state or the caller's side does not allow an offer (move_not_allowed), the listing is not on sale (listing_unavailable), or the other side moved first (deal_changed).

422.description: The amount is not a multiple of 1,000 or is outside the offer range (invalid_amount; field amount: step or out_of_range).

post.summary: Agree the deal at a price.
post.description:
The side facing an open price accepts it; the buyer may also accept
the listed price at any time while negotiating.

404.description: No such deal of the caller's (deal_not_found).

409.description: Nothing to accept (move_not_allowed), the listing is not on sale (listing_unavailable), the price has changed (price_changed), or the other side moved first (deal_changed).

post.summary: Turn down the other side's open price.
post.description: Works in any state of the listing and for a suspended account.

404.description: No such deal of the caller's (deal_not_found).

409.description: No open price of the other side (move_not_allowed), or the other side moved first (deal_changed).

post.summary: Take back the caller's own open price.
post.description: Works in any state of the listing and for a suspended account.

404.description: No such deal of the caller's (deal_not_found).

409.description: No open price of the caller's (move_not_allowed), or the other side moved first (deal_changed).

post.summary: Drop the agreed price, and a pending order with it; the deal negotiates again.
post.description: Works in any state of the listing and for a suspended account.

404.description: No such deal of the caller's (deal_not_found).

409.description: The deal is not agreed (move_not_allowed), or the other side moved first (deal_changed).

get.summary: List the caller's deals on one side, newest first.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: buying lists the deals where the caller is the buyer; selling, the seller.

post.summary: Ask for cash on delivery on an agreed deal.
post.description:
The buyer of an agreed deal with no open order, on a listing on sale,
with fewer than 3 open orders, to one of the buyer's addresses. The
order keeps a copy of the address as its recipient. It starts
pending; either side may cancel it until the seller creates the
shipment, and it is cancelled with seller_timeout when the seller has
created none 3 days later.

404.description: No such deal of the caller's (deal_not_found), or no such address of the caller's (address_not_found).

409.description: The deal is not agreed or has an open order, or the caller is the seller (move_not_allowed); the listing is not on sale (listing_unavailable); the saved pickup is absent (pickup_not_configured); the buyer has 3 open orders (cod_limit_reached); or the deal changed meanwhile (deal_changed).

post.summary: Create the shipment of a pending order.
post.description:
The seller, in one commit. manual: the seller made the shipment on
the carrier's own app and types its code; the server reads it with
the seller's account at that carrier. linked: the server makes it on
the seller's account at the carrier asked, GHTK or GHN, picked up
where pickup_from says. A saved_pickup selection is resolved and
journaled after the seller and order checks. A retry with the same
caller and Idempotency-Key recovers that invocation even if the saved
preference or address has since been removed. The order is shipped,
the listing is reserved for it, and
other buyers' pending orders on the listing are cancelled with
shipped_to_another. A parcel the carrier reports delivered ships
delivered. Checks, in order: the shipment's fields, for a manual one
the carrier's answer, then the order is the caller's, the order's
state, the listing, and for a linked one the carrier's answer. A
carrier the caller has not linked is 409 carrier_not_linked, once the
order is found to be the caller's to ship. A stack
without a carrier (CARRIER=none, production for now) answers 503
carrier_unavailable.

404.description: No such order of the caller's (order_not_found).

409.description: The order is not the deal's pending one, or the caller is the buyer (move_not_allowed); the listing is not on sale (listing_unavailable); the deal changed meanwhile (deal_changed); or the caller has not linked that carrier, or must link it again because its token no longer opens (carrier_not_linked, carrier_relink_needed).

422.description: The shipment breaks a rule, the carrier's report of a failed parcel included (invalid_shipment, with fields); the carrier does not know the tracking code (shipment_not_found); the carrier does not know the recipient's or the pickup's address (carrier_address_unknown); or the carrier refused the shipment, its words in details.reason (carrier_refused).

503.description: The stack has no carrier, CARRIER=none (carrier_unavailable).

put.summary: Correct the carrier and tracking code of a manual shipment.
put.description:
The seller, while the shipment is pending_pickup or in_transit. The
server reads the new code with the seller's account at that carrier,
as on creation, and takes its status. Checks, in order: the carrier and the code, the
carrier's answer, then the order is the caller's and its state.

404.description: No such order of the caller's (order_not_found).

409.description: The order is not shipped, its shipment is linked or no longer pending_pickup or in_transit, or the caller is the buyer (move_not_allowed); the deal changed meanwhile (deal_changed); or the caller has not linked that carrier, or must link it again because its token no longer opens (carrier_not_linked, carrier_relink_needed).

422.description: The carrier or the code breaks a rule, the carrier's report of a failed parcel included (invalid_shipment, with fields), or the carrier does not know the tracking code (shipment_not_found).

503.description: The stack has no carrier, CARRIER=none (carrier_unavailable).

post.summary: Confirm receipt of a shipped order.
post.description:
The buyer, at any time while the order is shipped, whatever the
carrier reports. The order is completed, the deal sold and the
listing sold.

404.description: No such order of the caller's (order_not_found).

409.description: The order is not the deal's shipped one, or the caller is the seller (move_not_allowed); or the deal changed meanwhile (deal_changed).

post.summary: Cancel this pending order; the deal negotiates again.
post.description:
The selected order must still be the deal's current pending order.
Either party may cancel, including a suspended caller. The response is
the canonical Deal, as returned by the other order mutations.

404.description: No such order of the caller's (order_not_found).

409.description: The order is historical or not pending (move_not_allowed), or the other side moved first (deal_changed).

get.summary: The selected order, its current deal and the public counterpart.
get.description:
Historical orders keep their own state. The buyer also receives own_review
and ticket (null without one). Those fields are absent for the seller.
Recipient and pickup fields follow the canonical Order's privacy rules.

404.description: Unknown order or caller outside its parties (order_not_found).

get.summary: One page of the caller's orders on one side, each with the public counterpart.
get.description:
Newest order first, paged by order ID. The buyer's rows also carry
own_review, as GET /v1/screens/order/{order_id} reads it; a seller's
rows have none. Recipient and pickup fields follow the canonical
Order's privacy rules.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: buying lists the orders where the caller is the buyer; selling, the seller.

get.summary: The caller's account, addresses, pickup preference and linked carriers.
The buyer's checkout before requesting COD.
get.description: The address is the selected owned address or the default; null with an empty book. Shipping estimate is initially null. This read makes no carrier call or write.

404.description: Unknown deal or caller outside its buyer (deal_not_found); explicit missing or foreign address (address_not_found).
Missing or foreign address (address_not_found).

422.description: Invalid contact phone (invalid_shipping_settings, with fields).

get.summary: Read a shipment from its carrier, for the seller's preview.
get.description:
Before the seller confirms a manual shipment or a corrected code.
The code is read with the caller's own account at that carrier. The
app warns, and does not block, when cod_amount differs from the
agreed price.

parameters.name: carrier
parameters.description: ghtk, ghn, spx, jt or viettel_post; another value is 422 invalid_shipment.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The tracking code, 1 to 50 characters once trimmed.

200.description: The shipment as its carrier reads it.

404.description: The carrier does not know the tracking code (shipment_not_found).

409.description: The caller has not linked that carrier, or must link it again (carrier_not_linked, carrier_relink_needed).

422.description: The carrier or the code breaks a rule (invalid_shipment, with fields).

503.description: The stack has no carrier, CARRIER=none (carrier_unavailable).

post.summary: Set the status of every shipment with a tracking code, as its carrier would.
post.description:
Served only with CARRIER=fake, which the dev and test stacks run, to
anyone, since the fake carrier's shipments move only through it.
Production runs CARRIER=none and does not serve it. It calls the entry point the real
carriers' reports will use. A closed order changes nothing.
delivered completes the order 3 days later unless the buyer
confirms first; failed fails it at once and releases the listing.

204.description: Taken, whether or not an order changed.

404.description: No order has a shipment with the tracking code (shipment_not_found).

422.description: The status is not pending_pickup, in_transit, delivered or failed (invalid_status).

get.summary: The carrier accounts the caller linked.

200.description: Linked accounts, GHN before GHTK, in code order.

parameters.name: carrier
parameters.description: ghtk or ghn; another value is 422 invalid_carrier.

put.summary: Link the caller's account at a carrier, or replace the one linked.
put.description:
GHTK: the seller's email and password, exchanged at once for the
shop's token through GHTK's partner API; the password is not stored.
GHN: the seller's token and ShopId, checked against GHN's shop list.
The token is stored encrypted and never returned.

422.description: The carrier refused the account (carrier_login_failed), or the carrier is not ghtk or ghn, or the body is the other carrier's (invalid_carrier).

503.description: The stack has no carrier, CARRIER=none (carrier_unavailable).

delete.summary: Unlink the caller's account at a carrier.

get.summary: The WebSocket that tells the open app what changed for the caller.
get.description:
Frames are JSON text messages of at most 4 KB. On connect the server
sends the caller's updates after `since` (none without it), or
`{"type":"reset","seq":N}` when the log no longer holds them, then
`{"type":"ready","seq":N}`. After that it sends each update as
`{"type":"update","seq":N,"kind":…,…ids}`, with the IDs of the Update
schema, in seq order, with no duplicate and no hole, and
`{"type":"typing","conversation_id":…}` when the other member types.
The app keeps the last seq and passes it as `since` on its next
connect; after `reset` it reloads everything.

The kinds, the IDs each carries, what logs one and who gets it:

- `message` (conversation_id, message_id): a message is written or
  its status changes. Every member of the conversation gets it once
  the message is sent; while it is processing, or after it failed,
  only the sender does.
- `read` (conversation_id): a member's read marker moves forward, for
  the other member; a member marks the conversation unread, or clears
  that mark by reading, for that member.
- `deal` (deal_id): each save of a deal: a move (an offer, accept,
  decline, withdraw, cancel), a COD order, or any change to its order
  (the shipment, the carrier's status, receipt, completion), for the
  buyer and the seller. Opening a deal logs no update, so its first
  one comes with the move after the opening.
- `notification` (notification_id): a notification is added, or an
  unread one with the same collapse key is bumped, for its recipient.
- `scam_warning` (conversation_id): a scam warning in the conversation
  is raised, grows, or is dismissed, for the warned member.
- `listing_read` (listing_read_id): a listing read (video, photo or
  link) starts or one of its steps is saved, for the account reading.
- `ticket` (conversation_id): a support ticket is created, its first
  message is attached, or it is resolved or reopened, for the ticket owner.

The app sends `{"type":"typing","conversation_id":…}` (at most one in
3 seconds per conversation reaches the other member) and, before its
access token expires, `{"type":"auth","token":…}` with the new one.

Close codes: 1001 server shutting down (reconnect at once); 4001 token
expired, invalid or another account's (refresh, then reconnect); 4003
account suspended (do not reconnect); 1008 a frame that is not JSON
text or has an unknown type, or more frames than 10 at once and one a
second after that; 1009 a frame over 4 KB. The server pings every 25
seconds.

get.summary: Search active listings; without q, browse them.
get.description:
Three ways to search, all under the person's filters and sorts. With q a
model reads the query; BM25 on its words, its Vietnamese rewrite against
listing text vectors and its English description against listing photos
are fused by weighted RRF. With photo, the photo against listing photos
alone. With like, the listing's title, text vector and photos. Without
any, the call browses, newest first by default, and category alone is the
category page. sort=nearby is the "Gần bạn" feed, which Home's first page
comes from. A model that fails leaves the lists it feeds out; q then
searches its raw words, with no understood and no chips. A signed-in
caller's first page with q is kept in the search history, and a
signed-in caller never sees the listings they hid nor those of an
account on either side of their blocks. With watch, a watch of the
caller's runs its query and filters. photo and watch need a signed-in
caller.

post.summary: A one-time ticket that opens an ops dashboard on its own host.
post.description:
The console asks for a ticket, then sends the browser to callback_url,
where the server turns the ticket into the dashboard's cookie. A
ticket opens the dashboard once, within 60 seconds, and only while
this session lives. Grafana takes a moderator; the other dashboards
take an admin. A dashboard that DASHBOARD_HOSTS gives no host is
dashboard_not_configured.

get.summary: Traefik's forwardAuth check in front of every ops dashboard.
get.description:
Traefik calls it with the dashboard request's Cookie and its
X-Forwarded-* headers; no console header. X-Forwarded-Host names the
dashboard through DASHBOARD_HOSTS, and the console_dashboard cookie
must belong to that dashboard and to a console session that still
lives, of a member whose role opens the dashboard. Without such a
cookie a GET is sent to the console, which asks for a ticket; any
other method gets 401. Traefik copies X-Console-Email and X-Console-Role
onto the request it lets through and drops a client's own.

parameters.name: X-Forwarded-Host
parameters.description: The dashboard's host; a port is ignored.

parameters.name: X-Forwarded-Uri
parameters.description: The path and query the browser asked the dashboard for.

parameters.name: X-Forwarded-Method
parameters.description: The dashboard request's method; absent counts as GET.

X-Console-Role.description: Admin or Viewer for Grafana, whose auth proxy reads its own role names; the member's role (admin, moderator) for the others.

302.description: No cookie for this dashboard. Location is the console's /dashboards/open?app=<app>&rd=<X-Forwarded-Uri>.

403.description: The member's role does not open this dashboard (console_forbidden), or DASHBOARD_HOSTS does not name the host (dashboard_host_unknown).

get.summary: Turn a dashboard ticket into the dashboard's cookie.
get.description:
Served on each dashboard's own host, where the Ingress routes
/_dashboard to the server without forwardAuth. The request's Host
names the dashboard. The ticket must be unused, unexpired, for this
dashboard and of a console session that still lives; it is spent here.
The answer sets console_dashboard (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax,
Path=/, no Domain, so only this host gets it) for as long as the
console session has left, and redirects to rd when rd is a path on
this host, to / otherwise.

parameters.name: rd
parameters.description: Where to go on this host afterwards, a path such as /d/abc?from=now-1h.

401.description: The ticket is unknown, used, expired, for another dashboard, or its console session has ended (invalid_dashboard_ticket).

403.description: DASHBOARD_HOSTS does not name this host (dashboard_host_unknown).

consoleAuth.name: console_session
consoleAuth.description:
The session cookie a console sign-in sets: HttpOnly, Secure,
SameSite=Strict, path /v1/console, eight hours. The server checks the
session and the member on every request.

dashboardAuth.name: console_dashboard
dashboardAuth.description:
The cookie of one ops dashboard's host, set by /_dashboard/callback:
HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, path /, no Domain. It lives as long
as the console session it came from, and the server checks that
session and its member on every request.

into a square; null removes the avatar.

display_name.description: The console member's name, or the OS user for the CLI.

details.description: What the action needs beyond its name, such as a suspension's reason and end. Never a secret.

AddIdentityRequest.description: Exactly one proof, of the kind the account lacks.

Address.description: Where the caller's parcels go. A COD request copies it into the order, so a later edit or delete leaves the order as it was.

is_default.description: Exactly one address of an account with any is the default.

AddressDraft.description: An address as the person types it. The rules are business rules; breaking one is 422 invalid_address.

name.description: The recipient's name, 1 to 50 characters after trimming.

phone.description: A Vietnamese mobile number, in any common form.

kind.description: home, work or other (AddressKind); another value is 422 invalid_address.

AddressKind.description:
What the place is, so the shipper knows when to deliver: home (Nhà),
work (Công ty), an office that takes parcels in office hours, or other
(Khác). A COD order carries it to the carrier.

items.description: The default first, then the newest.

Block.description: An account the caller blocks. Neither may message the other, open a conversation with them or open a deal on their listings.

next_cursor.description: Present when more blocks follow; pass it as cursor.

BuyerFigures.description: The caller as a buyer over the last 90 days.

cod_orders.description: The COD orders the caller placed.

failed.description: Of those, the orders whose delivery failed.

CancelReason.description:
buyer and seller: that side cancelled a pending order. seller_timeout:
the seller created no shipment within 3 days. pickup_timeout: the
carrier had not picked the parcel up 3 days after the shipment.
shipped_to_another: the seller shipped the listing to another buyer.
listing_closed: the listing was hidden, sold off the app or deleted.

Carrier.description: The carriers ShopNexus can read; there is no other.

CarrierAccount.description: A carrier account the seller linked. The token never leaves the server.

shop_code.description: GHTK's shop code or GHN's ShopId.

CarrierLogin.description: GHTK takes the seller's email and password; GHN takes the seller's API token and ShopId.

parent_code.description: Absent on a root. A listing takes a category with a parent.

items.description: The roots in order, then each root's subcategories in order.

ChatQuote.description: The message a reply quotes, as it reads now.

blocked.description: A block stands between the two, either way, so neither can send a message.

other_read_message_id.description:
The newest message the other member has read, for "Đã xem" under the
caller's messages up to it. Absent while they have read nothing.

deals.description: The deals of the two people on either side, newest first, as the caller sees them.

ticket.description: Present for a support chat, whose other side is ShopNexus.

Chip.description: A signal the model read from the query; off=<id> leaves it out.

CodCheckoutScreen.description: Buyer-only checkout. This read writes nothing and calls no carrier. The initial shipping estimate is null.

address_id.description: An address of the caller's from GET /v1/addresses. The order keeps a copy, so a later edit or delete of the address leaves it as it was.

items.description: By display name; empty for an unknown province.

actions.description: The 20 latest console actions on the account, newest first.

member.description: The member who wrote a ShopNexus reply; absent for the person's messages and for an automatic one.

automatic.description: A message ShopNexus sent by itself, such as the note when a carrier request closes.

reply_to.description: A sent message of the ticket's chat the reply quotes.

last_text.description: The last message's text, for the queue row.

same_carrier_30d.description: carrier_request only; tickets naming the same carrier in 30 days, this one included.

other_read_message_id.description:
The newest message the other member has read, for "Đã xem" under the
caller's messages up to it. Absent while they have read nothing.

listing_id.description: Someone else's active listing; the first message names it.

text.description: 1 to 1,000 characters after trimming, unless photos are sent.

photos.description: Up to 4 upload IDs of the caller's.

temporary_password.description: Shown once; the member must replace it at the first sign-in.

ticket.description: Opaque; opens the dashboard once within 60 seconds.

callback_url.description: https://<the dashboard's host>/_dashboard/callback?ticket=<ticket>. The console adds rd and sends the browser there.

app.description: Grafana opens for moderators and admins; the others for admins.

Deal.description: A buyer's negotiation with a seller over one listing; one per buyer and listing.

conversation_id.description:
The conversation of the buyer and the seller, which opening the deal
opened or reused. Each move a person makes and each order step adds a
message there.

next_cursor.description: Present when more deals follow; pass it as cursor.

DealListing.description: The deal's listing as it is now.

cover_thumb_url.description: Absent until the cover photo is processed.

DealStatus.description:
Agreeing reserves nothing; several buyers may agree a price on one
listing. sold: the deal's order was completed; the deal takes no move.

DealSummary.description: A deal at a glance, as the caller sees it.

conversation_id.description: The conversation of the buyer and the seller, which holds the deal's messages.

your_turn.description:
The caller has to act: the deal is negotiating and the open price is
the other side's; or the caller is the buyer of an agreed deal
without a pending or shipped order, on a listing still active; or
the caller is the seller and the deal's newest order is pending.

DevUpdate.description: An update to log for the caller, with exactly the IDs its kind carries.

resend_at.description: The first moment another code to this address is allowed.

email.description: Trimmed and lower-cased by the server.

Error.description: The body of every error response.

code.description: Stable, snake_case; clients map it to their own text.

fields.description: One entry per invalid field, keyed by its JSON path.

details.description: Values a client acts on, such as attempts_left or retry_after.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

next_cursor.description: Present when more follows follow; pass it as cursor.

password.description: Used once to get the shop's token; never stored.

HomeCategory.description: A root of the category tree.

notifications_unread.description: The reader's unread notices; 0 when signed out.

nearby.description: The first page of the nearby feed; no items without a position.

HomeSubcategory.description: A subcategory under a root of the category tree.

value.description: The number in the +84 form, or the address lower-cased.

InboxItem.description:
deal is the pair's deal the row is about, absent when the two have none:
the newest, by last move, of those where it is the caller's turn, else
the newest negotiating or agreed one, else the newest. order_status is
that of the deal's newest order. scam_warning is absent when the caller
has no warning in the conversation.

unread.description: The other member's sent messages after the caller's read marker; at least 1 while the caller's unread mark is set.

other_active_deals.description: The pair's negotiating or agreed deals besides deal.

next_cursor.description: Present when more conversations follow; pass it as cursor.

unread.description: The caller's unread messages over unarchived conversations, as GET /v1/me/unread counts them.

next_cursor.description: Present when more messages follow; pass it as cursor.

LinkedCarrier.description: The carriers a seller can link. The other carriers in Carrier cannot be linked yet.

carrier.description: ghtk or ghn, a carrier the caller linked; another value is 422 invalid_shipment, an unlinked one 409 carrier_not_linked.

pickup.description: home (the carrier picks the parcel up from the seller) or post_office (the seller brings it to one).

pickup_from.description: Where the carrier picks the parcel up, one of carrier_pickup_id, address_id or saved_pickup; absent, the carrier's default pickup point. The order keeps a copy.

carrier_pickup_id.description: One of the carrier's pickup points, from GET /v1/carrier-accounts/{carrier}/pickups.

saved_pickup.description: Use the caller's saved pickup address and contact phone with their current display name.

address_id.description: An address of the caller's from GET /v1/addresses.

url.description: The link without what tracks the share, as https://www.chotot.com/<list id>.htm.

title.description: The listing's title as Chợ Tốt shows it.

price.description: Whole đồng; null when the listing has no price between 10,000 and 1,000,000,000.

cover_url.description: The listing's first photo on Chợ Tốt's CDN.

link.description: The link the seller pasted to their own listing on Chợ Tốt.

url.description: The link the seller pasted to their own listing.
The old listing, for the seller's "Từ tin Chợ Tốt của bạn" line; only the seller sees it.

photo_count.description: Photos on the old listing; set after the read step.

published_at.description: When the listing first went on sale.

ListingDraft.description:
A listing the caller started and has not posted, kept for their other
devices until expires_at, 30 days after its last PUT. Photos a listing
took or that expired are left out.

ListingDraftInput.description:
A draft as the app has it. The server reads title, price and photos and
keeps body as it came, without reading it; the posting rules apply only
at POST /v1/listings.

schema_version.description: The layout of body, which the app defines.

price.description: Whole đồng, or null while the seller has typed none.

photos.description:
Upload IDs of the caller's, in order. A photo a listing took, or one
that expired, is dropped from the stored draft; an ID given twice is
kept once. Each photo kept is kept 30 days from this PUT.

body.description: JSON the app owns, as a string.

url.description: A presigned GET of the original upload, valid for an hour.

ListingInput.description:
A complete listing, to post or to replace one. The rules below are
business rules: breaking one answers 422 invalid_listing with an entry
per field.

description.description: At most 1,500 characters; may be empty.

category_code.description: A subcategory code from GET /v1/categories, such as phones.iphone.

photos.description: 1 to 10 upload IDs, in order; the first is the cover.

specs.description: Up to 20 label and value pairs.

gps.description:
The seller's position, sent only with their permission. The server
blurs it to about 1 km before storing it and never returns it. A
point farther than 30 km from the commune is 422 invalid_listing on
field gps.

next_cursor.description: Present when more listings follow; pass it as cursor.

ListingRead.description:
A read of a seller's video, photo or listing on Chợ Tốt into a listing
draft. Fields fill in as its steps finish: photos after the frames step
of a video or the copy step of a link, draft after the fill, estimate
when the read is done. A field not reached yet is absent, and so is a
field of another source. A video is deleted when its read ends; the read
is kept 24 hours.

photos.description:
A video's clearest frames in time order (at most 8), a link's
copies in the old listing's order, or the photo read.

contact_removed.description: A link read's; true when a phone number, Zalo or other contact was taken out of the description.

estimate.description: Only when status is done; null when neither the market nor the model gave a range.

ListingReadRequest.description: What to read, one of a video, a photo or a link.

distance_km.description:
Whole kilometres from the caller's position to the listing, 0 under
1 km; absent without a position. It sits beside the listing because
it depends on the request, and a Listing reads the same for everyone.

ListingStatus.description:
processing: the photos are being processed. active: on sale. hidden:
taken down by the seller. rejected: a photo was refused; the photo says
why, and an edit tries again. reserved: held while an order's parcel
travels; anyone may read it, and the seller cannot change it. sold: sold
off the app or through an order. deleted: removed by the seller; only a
save or a deal that names the listing still shows it. Only active and
reserved listings are public.

ListingViewer.description:
The reader's own ties to the listing, sent when the reader is signed in
and is not the seller.

saved.description: Whether the reader saved the listing.

conversation_id.description: The reader's conversation with the seller; absent when there is none.

Location.description: A commune and its province, with a point inside the commune rather than where a seller or the caller is.

email.description: As typed; the server trims and lower-cases it, so this has no email format check.

new_password.description:
Replaces the temporary password at the first sign-in; ignored
afterwards. 12 to 128 characters, not the email and not the current
password. Later calls send it as password.

code.description: The TOTP code, once the member has started or finished enrollment.

carrier.description: ghtk, ghn, spx, jt or viettel_post; another value is 422 invalid_shipment. The code is read with the caller's account at that carrier, so only a linked carrier works (409 carrier_not_linked).

tracking_code.description: 1 to 50 characters once trimmed. A code the carrier does not know is 422 shipment_not_found.

locked_until.description: Present while failed sign-ins lock the member's email.

Message.description:
A message a member wrote, or a deal message the server wrote for a move
on a deal of the two. A deal message has deal, an empty text and no
photos, and nobody can send one.

sender_id.description:
The member who wrote the message or made the move. A deal message
for a move by the system (a carrier's report, a timer) has the ID of
ShopNexus, so it counts as unread for both members.

status.description: Only the sender sees a processing or failed message.

failure.description: Why media refused a photo, on a failed message.

MessageDeal.description:
The move a deal message is about. Every move a person makes on a deal
writes one, and so does every order step, whoever made it. A change of
the listing (price_changed, offers_closed, listing_closed) writes none.

text.description: 1 to 1,000 characters after trimming, unless photos are sent.

photos.description: Up to 4 upload IDs of the caller's.

listing_id.description: A listing of either member the message is about.

reply_to.description:
A sent message of the same conversation the message quotes. A deal
message cannot be quoted. Anything else is invalid_message with
field reply_to.

next_cursor.description: Present when more messages follow; pass it as cursor.

url.description: Set once the photo is processed.

by.description: system is the server, following a change of the listing, a carrier's report or a timer.

amount.description:
The offered or agreed price, the new listed price on price_changed,
the order's price on cod_requested, the carrier's fee on shipped when it gave one.

MyAccount.description: The caller's own account, with how it signs in.

display_name.description: Empty until the person completes their profile.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

identities.description: How the account signs in. Posting, opening a deal and opening a chat need a phone.

text.description: What the notice says, in Vietnamese.

at.description: When it last changed; a newer move on the same deal moves an unread notice up.

next_cursor.description: Present when more notices follow; pass it as cursor.

NotificationSettings.description:
Which notices push. A switch that is off stops the push only; the notice
is still listed. Search watch notices push by each watch's own bell, and
the listing and account notices always push. No push goes out during
quiet hours.

offers.description: Offers, counters, agreements and their ends.

orders.description: COD requests, shipping, delivery, failed deliveries and cancellations.

price_cuts.description: A new low of a saved listing.

followed.description: A new listing of a seller the caller follows.

reviews.description: A new review of the caller.

amount.description:
Whole đồng in multiples of 1,000, inside the deal's offer_range. The
range is a business rule, so an amount outside it is 422.

OfferRange.description:
The amounts the viewer's next offer may take, both included. Absent when
the viewer may not offer now; the app bounds its input with it.

OpenPrice.description: The offer or counter waiting for the other side.

Order.description: A buyer's request for cash on delivery at the agreed price.

code.description: The order number, such as SN-100001.

completed_by.description: The stored completion actor; present on a completed order.

OrderItem.description: An order with its deal and its listing as it is now.

completed_by.description: The stored completion actor; present on a completed order.

OrderScreen.description: The selected order and its current deal. Buyer-only fields are absent for a seller.

next_cursor.description: Present when more orders follow; pass it as cursor.

OrdersScreenItem.description: An order with the other party and, on the buyer's rows only, own_review.

OrderStatus.description:
pending: the buyer asked for COD; either side may cancel. shipped: the
seller created the shipment; the listing is reserved. completed: the
buyer confirmed receipt, or 3 days passed after the carrier reported
the parcel delivered. failed: the carrier reported the delivery
failed; the deal negotiates again. cancelled: before the shipment, or
by the pickup timeout.

OwnReview.description: The buyer's review state. Dates and id are null before the first submission. Deleted reviews carry no stars or text. The seven-day window starts at the original created_at; locked uses the same boundary as edits and deletion.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

last_active_at.description:
When the person last had the app open, to the 30 seconds; absent
before the first time. The app shows "Đang hoạt động" under 5
minutes, otherwise how long ago.

deleted.description: The person deleted their account; display_name is empty and there is no avatar.

official.description: ShopNexus itself, the other side of every support chat.

copied.description:
True for a photo ShopNexus copied from the seller's own listing on
another site (POST /v1/listing-reads); false for one taken or picked in
the app, and until the photo is processed. Read only.

url.description: The photo, at most 1600 px on its long side; set once processed.

thumb_url.description: A 400 px thumbnail; set once processed.

failure.description: Why processing refused the photo, on a rejected listing.

photo.description:
A photo upload of the caller's, uploaded and not yet in a listing:
the cover. The read does not take it; post it in the listing.

PickupPoint.description: A pickup point the seller registered at the carrier.

source.description: market is similar listings on the platform; model is the AI's own guess.

sample_size.description: Listings behind a market range; 0 for model.

estimate.description: The range of the listings most like the draft; null under 5 of them or when the comparison failed.

suggestions.description: fast before market; empty under 3 sold listings. fast is left out unless it is below market.

similar.description: The most similar listings first, sold within 180 days or on sale and published within 90.

sold_prices.description: The prices of the compared listings that sold, ascending.

live_prices.description: The prices of the compared listings on sale, ascending.

watchers.description:
One row per search watch, muted ones too, that a listing of this
draft would match by category, condition, area and words. The app
counts the rows whose price range holds its price and whose
offers_only its offers switch allows.

PriceGuideRequest.description: The draft as it stands in the Giá step; ListingInput's fields that price an item.

commune_code.description: The listing's commune; distances and watch areas are measured from its point.

photos.description: The caller's waiting photo uploads, the cover first. Without photos the text alone is compared.

days.description: The median whole days from publication to sale at this price.

key.description:
address is done when the address book holds an address, bio when the
bio is not empty, phone when the account has a phone identity,
avatar when it has an avatar.

ProfileTasksScreen.description: Hoàn thiện hồ sơ. The app counts the steps done and takes the first step not done as the next.

tasks.description: Every step, in the order the screen shows them.

address.description: The default address of the caller's address book; null when the book is empty.

QuietHours.description:
In Vietnam time. The window may cross midnight; from is inside it and to
is not. A push skipped in the window is dropped, not delayed.

from.description: Start, as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock.

to.description: End, as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock; not the same as from.

average.description: The average stars over every review of the seller; 0 without reviews.

ids.description:
The notices this call marked read, as many as there were (the 90-day
retention bounds them). To undo it, pass them to POST
/v1/notifications/unread in chunks of at most 500.

ReadDraft.description:
ListingInput's fields as the AI filled them. Add commune_code (and gps
when allowed) and post it to POST /v1/listings. A field with a value is
one the AI filled.

category_code.description: A subcategory code, or empty when none was found.

description.description: The seller's own words, restated, or for a photo read what the photo shows; empty when there is nothing.

price.description: Whole đồng the seller said; null when they named no price.

allow_offers.description: True when the seller said the price is negotiable.

photos.description:
Upload IDs of the draft's photos, the cover first: a video read's
kept frames (at most 6), a photo read's photo, or a link read's
copies (at most 10).

upload_id.description: A photo upload of the caller's; post it in a listing's photos.

url.description: Where to read the JPEG, for one hour after this response.

Recipient.description: The buyer's address as the order copied it from the address book.

phone.description: In the +84 form. Absent for the seller on a cancelled order.

street.description: Absent for the seller on a cancelled order.

ReplyRate.description:
A conversation counts when another person started it about one of the
caller's listings, its first message is from the last 90 days, and that
message is more than 24 hours old or the caller has answered. It is
answered in time when the caller's first message in it came within 24
hours of the other person's first message.

percent.description: The conversations answered in time, as a percent of count, rounded down.

listing_id.description: The listing reported; absent for a report of an account.

account_id.description: The account reported, the seller for a listing.

conversation_id.description: The caller's conversation with the account the report came from; absent when none was named.
With account_id only, the caller's conversation with that account; another one is 422 invalid_report.

reason.description: banned, fake, scam or other; a business rule, so another value is 422.

note.description: At most 500 characters after trimming; may be empty.

ReputationCaps.description:
The caps every account has, and how much of each the caller uses.
listings counts the listings on sale, waiting for review, hidden or
refused, and those reserved for an order; cod_orders counts the
caller's orders as a buyer that are pending or shipped.

ReputationRating.description: The reviews the caller received as a seller, as the seller page counts them.

average.description: The average stars; null without reviews.

ReputationScreen.description: Uy tín của bạn. Every figure is read when the view is.

sold.description: The caller's listings sold, through an order or marked by hand, as the seller page counts them.

reply.description: The reply rate over the last 90 days; null while fewer than 5 conversations count.

deleted.description: The buyer deleted their account; display_name is empty and there is no avatar.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

created_at.description: The first submission; the review changes only for 7 days after it.

stars.description: 1 to 5; a business rule, so another number is 422.

text.description: At most 500 characters after trimming; may be empty.

next_cursor.description: Present when more reviews follow; pass it as cursor.

below.description: Tell when the price falls below this.

next_cursor.description: Present when more saves follow; pass it as cursor.

saved_price.description: The listing's price when it was saved.

alert_below.description: The save's own alert level; absent when it has none.

listing.description: The listing as it is now. A hidden or deleted listing shows its status alone.

category_code.description: The listing's subcategory, such as phones.iphone.

commune.description: The name of the listing's commune.

phone.description: A Vietnamese mobile normalized to +84 on save; invalid values are 422 invalid_shipping_settings with field phone.

code.description:
prepayment_request, off_app_contact, suspicious_link,
sensitive_info_request, impersonation, fake_payment_proof, pressure,
new_account or price_far_below. More may come; the app shows an
unknown code with the Info icon.

text.description: Vietnamese, written by the server, as "Tài khoản mới tạo 2 ngày".

ScamWarning.description: What the caller is told about the other member of a conversation; that member never sees it.

signals.description: Oldest first; at least one is a message code.

dismissed.description:
True while no message code has appeared since the caller last
dismissed the warning. The inbox shows the warning either way; Chat
shows its banner only when this is false.

SearchHistoryItem.description: A text search the caller made.

query.description: The words as the caller typed them.

title.description: The query with its first letter upper-cased.

category.description: The category the search understood; absent when none.

photo_url.description: The first result's photo; absent when the search found nothing.

SearchItem.description:
A listing as a browse surface shows it: a search page, Home's nearby
feed and the seller view. It carries no point of the listing.

category_code.description: The listing's subcategory, such as phones.iphone.

commune.description: The name of the listing's commune.

distance_km.description: Whole kilometres from the caller's position, 0 under 1 km; absent without a position.

next_cursor.description: Present when more listings follow; pass it as cursor.
Present when more listings follow, up to the 500th.

understood.description: The model's sentence of what was searched.

watch_id.description: The caller's watch of this query; absent signed out or when there is none.

counts.description: With a root category filter, the matches per subcategory.

query.description: The words as the caller typed them, trimmed.

area.description: The commune the watch searches from; absent without a place.

new_count.description: New listings since the caller last opened the watch; 99 means 99 or more.

category.description: A root or subcategory code from GET /v1/categories.

near_lat.description: With near_lng; turned into its nearest commune and not kept.

SellerProfile.description: The seller as the seller view shows them.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

sold.description: Listings sold, through an order or marked by hand.

on_sale.description: Listings active or reserved for an order on its way.

followers.description: How many accounts follow the seller.

last_active_at.description:
When the person last had the app open, to the 30 seconds; absent
before the first time. The app shows "Đang hoạt động" under 5
minutes, otherwise how long ago.

SellerSummary.description: The seller of a listing, as the listing view shows them.

avatar_url.description: A public 400 px square; absent without an avatar.

sold.description: Listings sold, through an order or marked by hand.

SellerViewer.description:
The reader's ties to the seller, sent when the reader is signed in and
is not the seller.

blocked.description: Whether either of the two blocks the other.

following.description: Whether the reader follows the seller.

conversation_id.description: The reader's conversation with the seller; absent when there is none.

current.description: True for the session the request was made with.

next_cursor.description: Present when more sessions follow; pass it as cursor.

Shipment.description: The parcel of a shipped order.

mode.description: linked is made on the seller's account at GHTK or GHN; manual, on a carrier's own app and typed by the seller.

fee.description: The carrier's fee in đồng; absent while the carrier has none.

delivered_at.description: When the carrier reported the parcel delivered; present while status is delivered.

ShipmentDraft.description: A manual shipment the seller made on a carrier's own app, or a linked one to make on the seller's account at GHTK or GHN.

ShipmentPickup.description: Where a linked shipment is picked up, as the order keeps it: a carrier's pickup point, or a copy of the seller's address.

ShipmentPreview.description: A shipment as its carrier reads it, before the seller confirms it.

cod_amount.description: What the carrier collects at the door, in đồng.

fee.description: The carrier's fee in đồng; absent while the carrier has none.

ShipmentStatus.description: Where the parcel is, as its carrier reports it.

status.description: pending_pickup, in_transit, delivered or failed; another value is 422 invalid_status.

fee.description: The carrier's fee in đồng, read-only.

pickup.description: An owned address reference and separate unverified contact phone. Deleting the address clears both; existing shipment copies stay unchanged.

is_new.description: True when this sign-in created the account; the app then asks for a profile.

SignInRequest.description: Exactly one proof, phone_token, google_token or email_code, and the device's name.

phone_token.description: The token Firebase returned for the verified number.

google_token.description: The ID token Credential Manager returned for the Google account; it proves the account's email.

device_name.description: Shown in the list of signed-in devices.

km.description: Whole kilometres from the draft's commune.

until.description: Absent for a suspension without an end.

id.description: The deal, listing, seller or search watch; empty for the account.

first_message_id.description: The message the app draws as the ticket's card; absent for a moment while the ticket opens.

first_message.description: The person's first message, the ticket's card: Hỗ trợ's second line, which names what a Yêu cầu khác asks.

carrier_name.description: carrier_request only; 1 to 50 characters after trimming (invalid_ticket).

body.description: The first message, at most 1000 characters after trimming; other needs at least 1 (invalid_ticket).

secret.description: Base32, for typing into an authenticator by hand.

TrackingCode.description: A manual shipment's corrected carrier and code.

carrier.description: ghtk, ghn, spx, jt or viettel_post; another value is 422 invalid_shipment.

Update.description: A change for the caller, in their update log; IDs only.

has_more.description: More updates follow the last one; ask again from its seq.

content_type.description:
A photo, or a product video for POST /v1/listing-reads. HEIC is
converted to JPEG by the app before uploading.

size.description:
Bytes: a video at most 50 MB, a photo at most 15 MB. A photo over
15 MB is 400 invalid_request on field size.

headers.description: Headers the PUT must carry, as signed.

video.description: A video upload of the caller's (video/mp4 or video/quicktime), uploaded and not read yet.

transcript.description:
What the phone's speech recognizer heard while the video was filmed,
taken as the seller's words. Blank or absent, the server hears the
video's sound. Never stored past the read, logged or returned.

BadRequest.description: The request does not match the API description (invalid_request, malformed_json).

ConsoleForbidden.description: The caller's role is too low (console_forbidden), or the target is an admin (admin_managed_by_cli).

NotFound.description: No such resource for this caller.

PreconditionRequired.description: The caller must do something first: sign in again (reauth_required), or at a console sign-in replace the temporary password (password_change_required), enroll TOTP (totp_enrollment_required) or send a code (totp_required).

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limited; details.retry_after gives seconds to wait when known.

Unauthorized.description: No valid credentials (unauthenticated, invalid_token, a refresh or session code, invalid_credentials, invalid_totp_code).

Unprocessable.description: Well formed, but a rule refuses it.

ConsoleCSRF.name: X-Requested-With
ConsoleCSRF.description:
Must be shopnexus-console on every console call. A form or link on another
site cannot set it, which stops cross-site requests riding the session
cookie, sign-in included.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page; absent for the first page.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A new UUID per user action, reused when the app retries that action. A repeated key returns the first result.

NearCommune.name: near_commune
NearCommune.description: A commune code, when the app has no GPS; distance is from its point.

NearLat.name: near_lat
NearLat.description: The caller's latitude, with near_lng. Used for this request only; never stored or logged.

RadiusKm.name: radius_km
RadiusKm.description: Keep the listings within this many kilometres of the position, which it needs.

SearchCursor.name: cursor
SearchCursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page.

SearchLike.name: like
SearchLike.description:
A listing on sale or reserved: listings similar to it, leaving out that
listing and the caller's own. Goes with q and the filters, not with photo.

SearchPhoto.name: photo
SearchPhoto.description:
An upload of the caller's from POST /v1/uploads, still waiting (attached to
nothing): search by this photo alone. Needs a signed-in caller; goes without
q and like. The photo is never published and goes when the upload expires.

SearchWatch.name: watch
SearchWatch.description:
A search watch of the caller's: search its query and filters from its
commune. Goes with cursor, limit, sort and off only, and needs a
signed-in caller. The first page sets the watch's new_count to 0.
